items.title: 52220_Woody Herman oral history interview
items.q: I think that some of us, like Buddy Rich and many others, successful people, just don't want to know about all that.

ctx.x: Uh-huh. I know Stan shares this view with you.

Yeah. But then, there are a lot of people, nonblacks, that never entered into the spirit of the educational process of trying to help, and I think that some of us, like Buddy Rich and many others, successful people, just don't want to know about all that.
They just ignore it, they say, 'Just let me play.'
